salmanshh_virtual_cursor.name: Virtual Cursor
salmanshh_virtual_cursor.description: Turns any world object into a controllable cursor with event-driven movement, Homing/Snapping magnet, solids, and interact input, that supports All Inputs e.g gamepad, touch, mouse, and keyboard.

maxSpeed.name: Max Speed
maxSpeed.desc: Maximum cursor movement speed in pixels per second.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.desc: Rate of acceleration toward max speed, in pixels per second squared.

deceleration.name: Deceleration
deceleration.desc: Rate of deceleration when axis input is zero, in pixels per second squared.

directionMode.name: Directions
directionMode.desc: Limits the axes the cursor can move along. Up & Down disables horizontal movement; Left & Right disables vertical movement; 4 Directions snaps to the dominant axis; 8 Directions allows full free movement.

allowSliding.name: Allow Sliding
allowSliding.desc: When enabled, the cursor slides along solid obstacles rather than stopping on contact. When disabled, all velocity is zeroed on any solid hit.

defaultControls.name: Default Controls
defaultControls.desc: If enabled, arrow keys control movement. Otherwise, use the Simulate Control actions to drive movement from the event sheet.

hoverMode.name: Hover Detection
hoverMode.desc: How 'Is Hovering' decides the cursor is over an object. Point: the cursor's origin point must be inside the target's collision shape (mouse-like). Overlap: the cursor's own collision shape must overlap the target's.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.desc: Which surfaces the cursor reflects off (a lossless bounce, like the Bullet behavior) instead of stopping or sliding. Best with momentum (Set Velocity); held axis input into a wall overrides it.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the behavior is initially enabled or disabled.

AddHomingTarget.description: Registers picked instances as homing targets the cursor steers toward.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object instances to add as homing targets

ClearHomingTargets.description: Removes all homing targets and resets the in-range state.

RemoveHomingTarget.description: Removes picked instances of an object from the homing targets list.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object instances to remove from homing targets

SetHomingEnabled.description: Enables or disables the homing magnet system.

SetHomingMode.description: Steer pulls the cursor gently toward the nearest target within the radius; Snap locks it directly on the target within the radius; Snap on collision locks on only while the cursor overlaps the target's collision shape.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Steer = gentle pull, Snap = instant lock-on by radius, Snap on collision = lock-on by collision overlap

SetHomingRadius.description: Sets the homing detection radius in pixels.

SetHomingStrength.description: Sets the pull strength used by Steer mode (0–1). Snap mode ignores this value.

SetHoverMode.description: Chooses how 'Is Hovering' detects hover: Point (cursor's origin point inside the target's collision shape) or Overlap (the cursor's own collision shape overlaps the target's).

PressInteract.description: Marks the named interact input as held and fires On Interact Pressed. Use a consistent ID string (e.g. "interact", "fire", "jump") to distinguish between multiple buttons.

ReleaseInteract.description: Clears the named interact input held state and fires On Interact Released. The ID must match the one used in Press Interact.

interactId.name: ID
interactId.desc: Interact input identifier — must match the ID used in Press Interact

SetAcceleration.description: Sets how fast the cursor speeds up when input is held, in px/s².

SetDeceleration.description: Sets how fast the cursor slows down when no input is held, in px/s².

SetMaxSpeed.description: Sets the maximum movement speed in pixels per second.

SetPosition.description: Deprecated — use 'Simulate Direct Mouse Position' instead. Instantly teleports the cursor to the given position (and updates velocity when called every tick). Kept so existing projects keep working.

SetVelocity.description: Directly sets the cursor velocity in pixels per second.

MoveToward.description: Instantly places the cursor at the given position, like a real mouse pointer. When called every tick (e.g. to follow the mouse or a touch point), it also updates the velocity so VelocityX/Y, Speed, MovingAngle and Is Moving reflect the movement.

targetX.name: X
targetX.desc: X position to place the cursor at

targetY.name: Y
targetY.desc: Y position to place the cursor at

SimulateAxis.description: Intended for analog sticks and virtual joysticks.

x.name: Axis X
x.desc: Horizontal axis value. Typical range -1 to 1; values outside are normalised down to unit length.

y.name: Axis Y
y.desc: Vertical axis value. Typical range -1 to 1; values outside are normalised down to unit length.

SimulateControl.description: Moves the cursor in a direction this tick only. Must be called every tick it should remain held.

SimulateInteract.description: Fires On Interact Pressed and On Interact Released for the given ID within the same frame. Does not set the held state. Use Press Interact + Release Interact separately when held state is needed.

SimulateMouse.description: Smoothly moves the cursor toward a target position each tick. Unlike Simulate Direct Mouse Position, uses exponential velocity smoothing for a natural ease-in and ease-out with no sudden stops. Call every tick.

smoothing.name: Smoothing
smoothing.desc: Follow responsiveness from 0 (frozen) to 1 (instant). Values around 0.1–0.3 feel like a smooth mouse cursor.

AddSolid.description: Registers picked instances as solids the cursor is pushed out of.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object instances to add as solids

ClearSolids.description: Removes all explicit solids from the solids list.

RemoveSolid.description: Removes picked instances of an object from the solids list.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object instances to remove from solids

SetAllowSliding.description: When enabled, only the velocity component perpendicular to the collision wall is zeroed — the cursor slides along the surface. When disabled, all velocity is zeroed on any solid hit.

state.name: State
state.desc: Enable or disable sliding along solid obstacles

SetSolidCollision.description: Enables or disables automatic solid collision for all Solid behavior instances.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether automatic solid collision is active

ClearCircularConstraint.description: Removes the circular constraint so the cursor moves freely again (the rectangular layout constraint, if any, still applies).

ResetCircularRotation.description: Zeroes the accumulated rotation (ConstraintRotation / ConstraintRevolutions). Call it when a spin challenge starts, or between the stages of a combination lock.

SetBounce.description: Chooses which surfaces the cursor reflects off (a lossless bounce, like the Bullet behavior) instead of stopping or sliding. Works on momentum (e.g. Set Velocity); held axis input into a wall overrides it.

SetCircularConstraint.description: Confines the cursor to a ring band around a center point. Set Min = Max to lock it to a ring it can only spin around (dials, wheels); set Min = 0 to let it roam a disc and snap back at Max (slingshot pull, joystick). Call every tick with an object's X,Y to make the center follow it.

cx.name: Center X
cx.desc: X position of the circle's center, in pixels

cy.name: Center Y
cy.desc: Y position of the circle's center, in pixels

minRadius.name: Min Radius
minRadius.desc: Inner radius in pixels. 0 = a full disc; equal to Max = a locked ring.

maxRadius.name: Max Radius
maxRadius.desc: Outer radius in pixels — the cursor can never get further than this from the center.

SetCircularReturn.display-text: {my}: Set circular return strength {0} home angle {1}
SetCircularReturn.description: Makes the cursor spring back to its rest position on the circular constraint when the player stops steering or dragging it. For a pull disc (Min radius 0) it snaps back to the center/origin (like an analog stick); for a ring or dial it returns to the given home angle (a self-centering steering wheel). Strength 0 disables it; higher is snappier. Requires an active circular constraint.

strength.name: Strength
strength.desc: How strongly/quickly the cursor returns to rest. 0 = off, ~0.3–0.6 typical, higher = snappier.

homeAngle.name: Home Angle
homeAngle.desc: Angle in degrees the cursor returns to on a ring/annulus (the 'straight' position). Ignored for a disc, which returns to the center.

SetConstraintBounds.description: Sets a custom constraint rectangle. Pass all zeros to reset to full layout bounds.

SetConstrainToLayout.description: Clamps cursor inside layout bounds and fires On Layout Edge Hit.

SetDefaultControls.description: Enable or disable the built-in arrow key controls. When disabled, use the Simulate Control action to drive movement from the event sheet.

state.name: Enabled
state.desc: Enable or disable default arrow key controls

SetDirectionMode.description: Limits the axes the cursor can move along. Up & Down disables horizontal movement; Left & Right disables vertical movement; 4 Directions snaps to the dominant axis per tick; 8 Directions allows full free movement.

SetEnabled.description: Enables or disables the Virtual Cursor behavior.

SetIgnoringInput.description: When enabled, all movement input is ignored — arrow keys are not read and every Simulate action (Simulate Control / Axis / Mouse / Direct Mouse Position / Interact) does nothing. The cursor coasts to a stop while still ticking; direct drives like Set Position and Set Velocity still work. Use it to freeze input for cutscenes or menus.

state.name: State
state.desc: Enable to ignore (freeze) input, disable to resume

IsInHomingRange.description: True when at least one homing target is within the homing radius.

OnHomingSnapped.description: Fires when the cursor teleports to a homing target in Snap mode.

OnHomingTargetEntered.description: Fires when the cursor enters the homing radius of a target.

OnHomingTargetExited.description: Fires when the cursor leaves the homing radius of all targets.

IsHovering.description: True while the cursor is over an instance of the given object, using the current Hover Detection mode. When several overlap, the front-most (top-layered) one is chosen. Hidden instances and instances on hidden layers are ignored. Records that instance — read HoveredUID and use System → Pick by UID to act on that exact instance. Wrap in System → Trigger once while true for an 'on hover enter' event.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Object type to test the cursor against

IsInteractHeld.description: True while the named interact input is pressed and not yet released. Leave ID empty to check if any interact input is currently held.

interactId.name: ID
interactId.desc: Interact input identifier, or empty string to check if any interact is held

OnInteractPressed.description: Fires when Press Interact is called for the given ID. Leave ID empty to fire for any interact press.

interactId.name: ID
interactId.desc: Interact input identifier to filter on, or leave empty to match any

OnInteractReleased.description: Fires when Release Interact is called for the given ID. Leave ID empty to fire for any interact release.

interactId.name: ID
interactId.desc: Interact input identifier to filter on, or leave empty to match any

IsMoving.description: True if the cursor has non-zero velocity.

OnLayoutEdgeHit.description: Fires when the cursor hits the layout boundary while constrained.

IsBlocked.display-text: {my}: Was blocked by a solid this tick
IsBlocked.description: True if the cursor was pushed out of a solid object this tick.

OnSolidHit.description: Fires when the cursor collides with a solid object and is pushed out.

IsCircularConstraintActive.description: True while a circular constraint is set (via Set Circular Constraint).

IsEnabled.description: True if the Virtual Cursor behavior is currently active.

IsIgnoringInput.description: True while movement input is being ignored (set via Set Ignoring Input).

OnBounce.description: Fires when the cursor reflects off a surface it is set to bounce on — a solid, a custom object, or a constraint edge. Fires once per tick.

OnCircularEdgeHit.description: Fires when the cursor first reaches the edge of the circular constraint. Outer = pushed out to Max radius (e.g. slingshot fully drawn); Inner = pulled in to Min radius.

CountHomingTargets.description: Returns the total number of registered homing targets.

GetHomingTargetUIDByIndex.description: Returns the UID of a registered homing target by index, or -1.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index into the homing targets list

HomingTargetDist.description: Returns distance to the nearest in-range homing target, or -1.

HomingTargetUID.description: Returns the UID of the nearest in-range homing target, or -1.

HoveredUID.description: Returns the UID of the front-most (top-layered) instance the cursor is hovering, as found by the most recent 'Is Hovering' check, or -1 if none. Use with System → Pick by UID to act on that instance (e.g. the item to highlight or grab).

Acceleration.description: Returns the current acceleration in pixels per second squared.

AxisX.description: Returns the current horizontal axis input value (-1 to 1).

AxisY.description: Returns the current vertical axis input value (-1 to 1).

CursorX.description: Returns the current X position of the cursor object.

CursorY.description: Returns the current Y position of the cursor object.

Deceleration.description: Returns the current deceleration in pixels per second squared.

MaxSpeed.description: Returns the current maximum movement speed in pixels per second.

MovingAngle.description: Returns the current movement angle in degrees based on the cursor's velocity vector.

Speed.description: Returns the cursor's current movement speed in pixels per second.

VelocityX.description: Returns the current horizontal velocity in pixels per second.

VelocityY.description: Returns the current vertical velocity in pixels per second.

CountSolids.description: Returns the total number of registered explicit solids.

SolidUID.description: Returns the UID of the last solid hit this tick, or -1.

BounceMode.description: Returns which Bounce type is active as a token: "none", "solids", "constraints", or "both" (solids and constraints).

ConstraintAngle.description: Angle in degrees (0–360) from the circular constraint's center to the cursor. The dial/spin angle. Returns 0 when no circular constraint is active.

ConstraintBottom.description: Returns the bottom edge of the active constraint region.

ConstraintCenterX.description: X position of the circular constraint's center. Returns 0 when no circular constraint is active.

ConstraintCenterY.description: Y position of the circular constraint's center. Returns 0 when no circular constraint is active.

ConstraintDistance.description: Current distance in pixels from the circular constraint's center to the cursor. The pull / draw length. Returns 0 when no circular constraint is active.

ConstraintLeft.description: Returns the left edge of the active constraint region.

ConstraintMaxRadius.description: Outer radius of the active circular constraint, in pixels — handy for sizing a boundary ring sprite. Returns 0 when no circular constraint is active.

ConstraintMinRadius.description: Inner radius of the active circular constraint, in pixels. Returns 0 when no circular constraint is active.

ConstraintPull.description: How far the cursor is drawn within the constraint band, normalized 0–1 (0 = at Min radius, 1 = at Max radius). Ideal for slingshot/joystick power. Returns 0 when inactive or Min equals Max.

ConstraintRevolutions.description: Accumulated rotation expressed as full turns (ConstraintRotation / 360) — signed and fractional, e.g. 1.5 = one and a half turns one way, -3 = three turns the other. Ideal for 'spin N times to unlock' checks. Zero it with Reset Circular Rotation.

ConstraintRight.description: Returns the right edge of the active constraint region.

ConstraintRotation.description: Total accumulated rotation in degrees while a circular constraint is active — signed (one spin direction adds, the other subtracts) and unbounded, so a full turn reads 360, two turns 720. Use abs() if direction doesn't matter. Zero it with Reset Circular Rotation.

ConstraintTop.description: Returns the top edge of the active constraint region.
